theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Eligible, top-ranked, breadth 0.875, and not crowded. Trend-gate discipline supports staying with the leader while it remains above its absolute trend — but this is a focus/size-and-de-risk read, not a return forecast.

theses.subject: Robotics & Automation
